tasks.title: Add Environment Variable Validation
tasks.description: Implement validation logic to check for required environment variables (NOTION_API_KEY, NOTION_DATABASE_ID) at startup. Throw descriptive errors if missing or invalid.
acceptance_criteria: Application exits gracefully with clear error message if env vars missing
Validation occurs before any API calls
Error messages indicate which specific variable is missing
tasks.technical_approach: Add validation function that checks process.env values before Client initialization

tasks.title: Implement Structured Error Handling
tasks.description: Create comprehensive error handling for all Notion API interactions. Include retry logic for transient failures and meaningful error messages for client errors.
acceptance_criteria: All async functions handle errors gracefully
Network errors trigger retry mechanism (max 3 attempts)
Client errors (4xx) return descriptive messages without retry
Errors are logged with context information
tasks.technical_approach: Wrap API calls in try-catch with error classification and conditional retry logic

tasks.title: Add Input Validation for Task Creation
tasks.description: Validate all input parameters for createTask function including title length, assignedTo format, and notes content before making API calls.
acceptance_criteria: Title length does not exceed Notion limits (2000 chars)
Notes field has reasonable length limits
tasks.technical_approach: Add validation helper function called at start of createTask

tasks.title: Implement Task Query Functionality
tasks.description: Add function to retrieve tasks from Notion database with filtering capabilities (by status, assignee, date range).
acceptance_criteria: Can query all tasks from database
tasks.technical_approach: Create queryTasks function using notion.databases.query with filter parameters

tasks.title: Add Task Deletion Capability
tasks.description: Implement function to archive/delete tasks from Notion database with confirmation mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: Can archive task by page ID
Includes safety check to prevent accidental deletion
tasks.technical_approach: Use notion.pages.update with archived: true property

tasks.title: Expand Status Options
tasks.description: Extend supported task statuses beyond 'To-do' and 'Done' to include 'In Progress', 'Blocked', 'Review', and 'Cancelled'.
acceptance_criteria: All status values defined as constants
UpdateTask accepts all new status values
tasks.technical_approach: Define status enum and add validation in updateTask

tasks.title: Implement Pagination Support
tasks.description: Add pagination handling for queryTasks to support databases with >100 tasks using Notion's cursor-based pagination.
acceptance_criteria: Automatically fetches all pages of results
Does not timeout on large datasets
tasks.technical_approach: Implement recursive or iterative pagination using has_more and next_cursor

tasks.title: Add Bulk Operations Support
tasks.description: Create functions for bulk task creation and bulk status updates to improve efficiency when processing multiple tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Can create multiple tasks in single operation
Can update multiple task statuses simultaneously
Includes error handling for partial failures
tasks.technical_approach: Use Promise.allSettled for parallel operations with individual error tracking

tasks.title: Implement Logging Framework
tasks.description: Add structured logging using a logging library (e.g., winston or pino) with configurable log levels and output formats.
acceptance_criteria: Logs include timestamps and severity levels
Supports multiple log levels (debug, info, warn, error)
Can output to console and file
Log level configurable via environment variable
tasks.technical_approach: Install winston, create logger instance, replace console.log/error calls

tasks.title: Create CLI Interface
tasks.description: Build command-line interface for manual task operations using a CLI framework (e.g., commander or yargs).
tasks.technical_approach: Create separate CLI entry point using commander.js with subcommands

tasks.title: Add Unit Tests
tasks.description: Create comprehensive unit test suite using Jest or Mocha covering all core functions with mocked Notion API.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover success and error scenarios
Tests run via npm test command
tasks.technical_approach: Install jest, mock @notionhq/client, create test cases for each function

tasks.title: Add Integration Tests
tasks.description: Create integration test suite that validates actual Notion API interactions using test database.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use separate test Notion database
Tests create, read, update, delete real tasks
Tests skip if credentials not provided
Documented setup instructions for test environment
tasks.technical_approach: Create separate test file using real API with test database ID from env

tasks.title: Create API Documentation
tasks.description: Generate comprehensive API documentation covering all exported functions, parameters, return values, and error conditions.
acceptance_criteria: JSDoc comments on all public functions
tasks.technical_approach: Add JSDoc annotations and create comprehensive markdown documentation

tasks.title: Add CI/CD Pipeline Configuration
tasks.description: Create GitHub Actions workflow for automated testing, linting, and validation on commits and pull requests.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow runs on push and pull request
tasks.technical_approach: Create GitHub Actions YAML with Node.js setup and test/lint steps

tasks.title: Implement Configuration Management
tasks.description: Create flexible configuration system supporting multiple environments (dev, staging, prod) with validation and defaults.
tasks.technical_approach: Create config module that loads and validates environment-specific settings
